text:
On how to avoid problems

Buffett: "When we bought See's Candy, I spent an hour there. Every business we've bought on one call."

"If I need a team of lawyers and accountants, it isn't going to be a good deal...If it's going to be that way, I don't want to deal with them -- because it's going to ruin my life sooner or later. So we just walk away."
